title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
authors: E. Hu, Y. Shen, P. Wallis, et al. (8 authors)
before: Fine-tuning updated every weight and produced a full-size copy per task.
problem: A 175B model cannot be fine-tuned, stored or served per task by most organisations.
breakthrough: Freeze the base model and train a small low-rank update alongside it, often under 1% of parameters.
why: It turned fine-tuning from a datacentre operation into something you can do on one GPU.
next: QLoRA added quantization; adapters became the standard customisation route.
inherits: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning, the default way people specialise open models.
